name: What are the common challenges in valuing oceanfront condos in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges in valuing oceanfront condos in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in valuing oceanfront condos in South Florida include the high variability of comparable sales due to unique views and amenities, fluctuating market conditions, and the impact of potential environmental factors like sea-level rise. The sheer volume and diversity of luxury properties in areas like Palm Beach and Collier County also necessitate deep local market knowledge to accurately assess true market value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include variable comparable sales, fluctuating market conditions, environmental factors, and the diverse luxury properties in South Florida.
